snippet.title: Legion In Focus
snippet.description:
Releasing on 27 May, the Legion expansion introduces a host of new and exciting innovations, adjustments, and additions. These include Freelance Jobs, new ships, new sovereignty upgrades, and much more. This In Focus video gives an overview of what lies ahead. 

Learn more about Legion at: https://www.eveonline.com/news/view/legion-in-focus

-- Content of this Video --
00:00 - Freelance Jobs
01:44 - Corporation Branding - Corp pallet
02:24 - New Ships
02:54 - Sarathiel
03:14 - Babaroga
03:36 - New sovereignty upgrades
04:30 - Skyhook capture
05:03 - Improved Remote repair gameplay
05:35 - Visual upgrades
